//: Type-checking configuration for the hand-written browser scripts under
src/main/resources/static/js. TypeScript runs here as a CHECKER ONLY
(noEmit) — nothing is compiled, no bundle is produced and no script tag
checkJs is TRUE: every script is checked, with no per-file opt-in, and
strict, noImplicitAny and useUnknownInCatchVariables stay on; the ratchet
(typecheck-ratchet.json, REQ-FE-018) holds the options and the domain
manifest. Nothing under `exclude` may hide a checked script.
moduleDetection is `force`: every script is checked as an ES module with its
own scope, as the browser runs it (ADR-0250); the one classic script, the
krt-client-error.js beacon, shares nothing with another file. `paths` maps the
absolute /js/ specifiers of the modules to the script folder.
